# Project Observatory

A local observation layer for agent-operated projects, part of the ssheleg harness.
The portable edition supports explicit project enrollment, repository state and
local metrics, credential metadata, opt-in known-value exposure scans, and a local
dashboard. Start with the synthetic demo and agent-led onboarding.

- Source: https://github.com/ssheleg/project-observatory-open-source
- Onboarding: https://github.com/ssheleg/project-observatory-open-source/blob/main/docs/ONBOARDING.md
- Security: https://github.com/ssheleg/project-observatory-open-source/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Migration scope: https://github.com/ssheleg/project-observatory-open-source/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION.md
- Harness: https://skills.sshlg.me/harness/

Cloud-provider adapters, shared MCP and scheduling are migration work, not included
in this edition. Examples on the site are synthetic. A known-value match identifies
local exposure, not remote exfiltration. Scanning is not a guarantee that no secret
remains. Secrets should be entered locally, never pasted into an agent conversation.
